title: 2017 – Connected City Conference
author: hkwtia
plainText: WTIA organised the Connected City Conference and industry experts were invited to present their latest solutions on 5G, LoRaWAN, Sigfox and NB-IoT to build Hong Kong as a smart-city. This is the first Smart City event that centres on connectivity and the newest networks gathered in one setting to discuss IoT, data, security and all the essential ingredients for a truly empowering Smart Hong Kong.
